Only the final keyframe is declared. Starting CSS transform is the implicit initial value: scale(0.4) grows while scale(2) shrinks; steps(4) vs steps(7) and 0.7s vs 0.9s also differ.

Same moving gradient primitive, but transparent stop span is 30%-70% vs 40%-60%, alpha 0.1 vs 0.08 and duration 2s vs 2.5s. Keep as style/timing variants; browser may further establish perceptual similarity.
Same fade cycle and four-child topology, but 12x3px bars with 3px radius vs 10x4px with 2px radius and four different offsets; preserve geometric variants.

Shadow X coordinates 9999px vs 9984px differ by 15px. Original .dot-falling shifts left by -9999px, using main/before/after shadows at 0/-15/+15px as three companion parts, with 0.1s/0s/0.2s delays. Stored single-keyframe samples omit the required base positioning and companions; numerical closeness is a coordinate-origin artifact.
